info.title: Smart Glasses Middleware API
info.description: A comprehensive middleware API for smart glasses that processes audio, images, videos, and text with AI-powered task detection and intelligent routing. Features include RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) indexing for all uploaded files, making them easily searchable and referenceable by AI.

This endpoint reduces network overhead by consolidating what would normally require 3 separate API calls into a single request. Supports selective inclusion and configurable item limits. Responses are cached for 30 seconds to improve performance.

post.summary: Process media files (images, videos, audio) with optional AI prompt
post.description:
Accepts multipart/form-data with media files and optional prompts. All uploaded files are stored in MinIO, processed through RAG indexing, and analyzed by AI. Audio files are automatically transcribed. This endpoint supports multiple file uploads and processes them asynchronously. Fields:
- files: One or more media files (images, videos, audio)
- prompt: Optional text prompt for AI processing
- promptAudio: Optional audio file containing the prompt (mutually exclusive with prompt)
- manifest: Optional JSON array specifying file processing order
- perFileTranscriptions: Optional JSON object mapping filenames to transcriptions

Supported file formats:
- Images: .jpg, .jpeg, .png, .gif
- Videos: .mp4, .avi, .mov
- Audio: .wav, .mp3, .m4a, .flac, .aac

Retrieves a paginated list of all files uploaded through the admin panel. All files returned have been processed through the RAG system for AI searchability. Supports caching for improved performance.

post.summary: Upload a new file with label
post.description: Uploads a file to MinIO storage, saves metadata to PostgreSQL, and automatically processes it through the RAG system for AI indexing. The file becomes immediately searchable and referenceable by AI. Files are deduplicated by content hash - if the same file is uploaded again, the existing file is returned instead of creating a duplicate.
